timeline.text: Fifty articles a day. Every one of them needed a decision, and every decision meant opening something else.
Pick the picture. Pick the language. Pick where it goes. Hours of it, every single day.
Now it all happens inside one Telegram message, the way a form fills itself in as you tap.
The message rewrites itself after every tap. Same bubble, next question. Nothing to open, nothing to type.
Hours per article became eight seconds. Four taps, and it is published.
